criteria.title: Приёмка в браузере на стенде
criteria.how: steps 1, 2, 5 and 6 (given to RELEASE-VALIDATOR) repeated on an own stand of 456 rows in two sessions (roles A «Проверка безопасности» with two runs, B «Ревью кода», an orchestrator record, a task begun outside the window of a request); the other steps by the records: docs/uat/REQ-046-RUN.md, docs/uat/REQ-046-047-048-049-RUN.md, BA-ANALYST PASS (handoffs/REQ048-20261015-01/step-08c-ba-analyst-r1.json). Stand: an own Pixel Office server started with `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 0 --dir <outside the project>/stand-…` and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR set to the same folder; events written only through the real `src/pixel-office/hook.sh` (26 events: main session sample-1 with an owner request, 10 role runs, B launched by A, two ends, Stop) and one orchestrator record through `src/pixel-office/note.js`; the owner journal, its copies and the ports 4780, 4782, 4790 were not used. Browser: Google Chrome headless, a new profile per page, driven over the debugging protocol with real mouse and key events; Chrome and the stand were stopped by their process ids. Results: <outside the project>/uat/res/po1…po5.json, shots in <outside the project>/uat/res/shots/.
criteria.evidence: Step 5: «200 из 456» → two presses of «Показать более ранние» → «456 из 456», the button is gone, the first row is the first line of the stand journal (SessionStart sample-1). Step 1: «Агент» = «Проверка безопасности» — rows 2, 5, 29, 31, 33, 35, exactly the rows of the file with that agent_type (starts, continuation, end and the handoff made by A; the handoffs to A from the main session are not in it); plus «Тип события» = «Агент получил задание и начал работу» — 2 rows, both starts of A; «Сбросить фильтры» — «200 из 456». Step 2: «события этой задачи» — mark «Задача: Проверка безопасности номер sample-a», 3 rows of the task; the «×» removes the mark. Step 6: search «вторая проверка» — «4 из 4», the start, the handoff, the continuation and the end of that task only.
